capturedEnglish.description: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks. Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike. Lasts 10 seconds or until the attacks are used.
capturedEnglish.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Side Gunner attacks becomes Flak Cannon attacks.
capturedEnglish.name: Flak Cannon
capturedEnglish.superUpgrade: Super: Grants Side Gunner: attacks enemy units within 700 units every 1.2 seconds, prioritizing furthest unit away within its range.

capturedEnglish.description: The caster surrounds themselves with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, leaving him unharmed. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around the caster while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
capturedEnglish.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Passive: Twice as powerful Radiance effect.
capturedEnglish.name: Flame Guard
capturedEnglish.superUpgrade: Super: +50 Damage Per Second, +280 Magic Damage Absorbed, and -28s cooldown.

capturedEnglish.description: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem. Gains a percentage increase to strength and imbues attacks with a slow and damage amplification.
capturedEnglish.differences: Caster becomes melee in Flesh Golem form.
capturedEnglish.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Gain a 10% chance to cast Soul Rip on the target on attack, and a 10% chance to cast Soul Rip on themselves when attacked.
capturedEnglish.name: Flesh Golem
capturedEnglish.superUpgrade: Super: +10% damage amplification, +10% extra strength, reduces Flesh Golem Cooldown by 30s and causes caster to spawn one zombie on each attack while transformed. Spawned zombies lasts 15s.

capturedEnglish.description: Gives the hero a guaranteed damage block against all types of damage. Passively grants bonus strength that increases each time this hero kills an enemy Hero or it dies in their vicinity.
capturedEnglish.differences: Does not gain Strength permanently until Super.
capturedEnglish.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: 2x damage block and 2x strength gain.
capturedEnglish.name: Flesh Heap
capturedEnglish.superUpgrade: Super: Permanently gains +2 Strength per enemy that dies in 450 range.

capturedEnglish.description: Channels the wind to gain 450 additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage. Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
capturedEnglish.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Focus Fire has no mana cost, and kills reset cooldown.
capturedEnglish.name: Focus Fire
